takeaways: Building a portfolio with full product-discovery docs, a functional spec, and ADRs makes the process itself a work sample of senior engineering.
A forward-only pipeline (discovery → spec → ADRs → TDD → code → release) ensures every implementation traces back to a locked decision.
Writing requirements and tests before code eliminates implementation thrash and makes edge cases explicit rather than accidental.
Documented decisions compound over time: future versions start from a versioned baseline instead of reverse-engineering intent from code.
